explain.en: Models and datasets downloaded from ModelScope. They are downloaded again when a program needs them. Other things ModelScope keeps nearby (saved ms-swift training settings, skills) and your login are not included.
explain.zh: 从魔搭 ModelScope 下载的模型和数据集。程序需要时会重新下载。旁边存的其他东西（ms-swift 保存的训练设置、技能）和你的登录信息都不包括在内。

notes: Only the download folders: models/ and datasets/ under the cache root (modelscope-hub 0.4.6: {cache}/{type}s/...) and under hub/ (older SDKs: get_model_cache_root = <cache>/hub/models). The rest of ~/.cache/modelscope is left out on purpose: hub/swift-web-ui holds ms-swift Web-UI training settings the user saved, and skills/ (modelscope download --type skill without --local-dir) can hold unpublished skills. Credentials are in ~/.modelscope/credentials. Older flat layouts (hub/<owner>/<name>) are not covered. MODELSCOPE_CACHE is read-only like every override. Not present on the maintainer's Mac.
